description: This file contains data access functions for job listings in a backend service, using SQLAlchemy for database interactions. It provides functions to list, retrieve, create, update, and delete job records.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] list_jobs(db: Session, q: Optional[str] = None, location: Optional[str] = None, limit: int = 20, offset: int = 0)
methods.description: Lists published jobs with optional search filters for query and location, returning a list of job summaries.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] get_job(db: Session, job_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information for a single job by its ID.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] create_job(db: Session, employer_id: str, data: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Creates a new job entry associated with an employer, returning the newly created record.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] update_job(db: Session, job_id: str, data: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Updates fields of an existing job identified by ID, returning the updated record if successful.

methods.name: bool delete_job(db: Session, job_id: str)
methods.description: Deletes a job record by ID, returning a boolean indicating success.
